title: PU-12M lesson 2: the radiotelephone operator
status: A seat lesson (docs/TUTORIALS.md): step by step, each control highlighted, the next step only once it is done.
source: sam3d; the moves, their order and their waits are the console's procedures (data/procedures/pu12m.json: deploy_mast) and the crew data's reports (data/crew/pu12m_crew.json), with their sources
notes: The battery commander's orders are given by the lesson (on_start) at the learner's pace.

steps.title: The radiotelephone operator's seat
lines: You are the radiotelephone operator (No. 3): on the bench at the left.
You keep the post in touch: the R-123M FuG-2 and the R-111 FuG-3 to the regiment, the mast that lifts their aerials, and the power board that feeds the equipment.
Each step lights up what to use; only that works. Read, then press Enter.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The R-111 (FuG-3)
lines: In front of you, low: the R-111, the long-range set to the regiment's command post (25-30 km).
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The R-123M (FuG-2)
lines: Above it, an R-123M: the covered unit's net.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The ŠČR distribution board
lines: On the wall at your left: the ŠČR board, which switches the 220 V to the equipment, and the VS-27 rectifier that keeps the batteries charged.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The mast's winch
lines: Across the post: the winch of the telescopic mast, 16 m up when raised and guyed.
steps.hint: L: look at it.   Enter: next.

steps.title: The commander: «Пункт управления развернуть!»
lines: The battery commander orders the post deployed. Your part: the radios, the mast, and the power to the equipment.
steps.hint: Enter: next.   Mouse: look round.   L: turn your head to what is highlighted.

steps.title: The R-123M on: ПИТАНИЕ
steps.why: A radio's valves take a while to warm: on first, used later.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The R-111 on
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Raise the mast
lines: Raise the mast: get up and work the winch (it is beyond your seat; L takes you there).
steps.why: Up 16 m the aerials see over the trees and the folds of the ground: the regiment's net reaches the post.
steps.hint: L: step to it.   Left click.

steps.title: 220 V to the equipment: ŠČR on
lines: When the driver has the AB-1 on line, switch the 220 V through to the equipment on the ŠČR board.
steps.why: The board waits for the driver's power: switched on before, it would switch nothing.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: The VS-27 rectifier on
lines: Switch the VS-27 on: it charges the batteries from the 220 V.
steps.hint: Point the cross at it, left click.

steps.title: Report it: «Мачта поднята!»
lines: Tell the commander: O, then «Мачта поднята!» (Mast up!).
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: Report it: «Связь с КП полка есть!»
lines: When the R-111 has warmed up: O, then «Связь с КП полка есть!» (In touch with the regiment!).
steps.hint: O: your reports, then the highlighted line's number.

steps.title: The crew deploys
lines: Your part is done. The squad leader orients the post, the commander turns on the ASPD-U and his radios.

steps.title: The radiotelephone operator's part: done
lines: That is your part: the radios on, the mast up, the power through to the equipment, and your reports.
Esc, then M: the missions menu, and the next seat's lesson.
